content:
Although it's not new for Claude to use a computer on the desktop, being able to run in the background is indeed a welcome upgrade.

Anthropic announced today that the background computer use feature for Claude Code is now available, currently limited to macOS and only for Pro and Max subscribers.

After integrating the original Codex into ChatGPT, OpenAI was the first to bring background computer use functionality to Mac earlier this year. It's great to see Anthropic's Claude Mac app improving on their version.

AI-driven computer use features lose much of their practical value if they mean handing over mouse control to an agent. But when running in the background, they can significantly boost a Mac's multitasking capabilities.

Learn more about Claude's computer use features in Code and Cowork.
